title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to add a “TAB” character to a string via AL
summary: The post explains how to add a TAB character to a string in AL code by using its ASCII character code (9) instead of trying to type it directly. This technique is useful for barcode generation and string formatting when TAB characters are needed as delimiters.
key_points: TAB character cannot be typed directly using the keyboard TAB key; use ASCII code 9 instead
Create a Char variable and assign it the value 9 to represent the TAB character
Concatenate the TAB character with other strings using the plus operator
TAB-delimited strings can be split later using appropriate string manipulation methods
